svg.text: Under the Lamp
Pierced screen: the table lamp throws your name onto your plate. The card itself reads upside-down; light un-warps it.
cut
fold / score
lemon card #feed95, black print

g.text: foot x2 — slots into the card

svg.text: 223 mm
cut file (laser or plotter-cut, front view as the guest sees it)
No ink on the pierced zone: black band + name only along the bottom 13 mm.
Bridges (stencil islands for o, p, a) 1.0-1.6 mm; use 350 gsm to survive handling.
Per-seat file: pattern is re-computed from the floor plan (lamp x, y) by script.
section through the table, seen from the end
name lands here
plate 270
guest eye 430 above / 450 from card
cone lamp, bare bulb 300 mm up
lamp marked 450 mm beyond card
card 84 mm
Shadow = projection of the holes through the bulb onto the plate (z=0):
Y = D*z/(H-z), x_shadow = x*H/(H-z) (D 450, H 300)
Hole at height z on the card → shadow at depth Y; pre-warped so the eye at
(0,-450,430) sees an upright, undistorted two-line name.
Needs: clear filament / LED bulb ≤ 25 mm, lamp on its taped mark ±60 mm.
